findings.description: profileMenuRef is typed as HTMLDivElement and attached to a wrapping div, but the button is inside that div. Clicking a child element of the button (avatar, text, chevron) may not toggle the menu reliably because the click-outside handler's contains check returns true for elements inside the ref'd div.
findings.action: Move the ref to the button itself and check if (!buttonRef.current?.contains(e.target) && !dropdownRef.current?.contains(e.target)), or ensure the button's onClick uses e.currentTarget to always capture the toggle event.
